item.title: Social Lockpicking Afternoon 0x2
item.description:
[CFG]Cruquiusweg fun group Was always curious about Lockpicking?
Join our social Lockpicking fun event - a casual, beginner-friendly drop-in workshop at **[Boefzak](https://www.instagram.com/boefzakamsterdam/).**
Learn a new skillset, get to know how a common lock works, and remember to always wield new skills ethically! A wide variety of locks and lock-picking tools will be waiting for you. But opening locks could be much more interesting, when you can get some **l00t**!
Test your skills on dozens of **treasure boxes** filled with l00t and rewards. What’s inside? There’s only one way to find out.
No experience needed. Just bring a good mood and enjoy the challenge.
